question_text: A booking system stores MemberID, MemberName, GuideID, GuideName, DepartmentID, DepartmentName, BookingID, StartTime. Each guide belongs to one department. MemberID determines MemberName; GuideID determines GuideName and DepartmentID; DepartmentID determines DepartmentName. Each unique BookingID refers to one member and guide at StartTime. Construct a 3NF schema with keys.
adaptation_rationale: Supplies explicit dependencies and booking identity rather than inferring functional dependencies from a UI screenshot.
